Deploy two subagents in parallel with the Agent tool (subagent_type "Explore", run in background):
1. "count files": count the files in this repo with `git ls-files | wc -l`, then run `sleep 20`, then report the count.
2. "read readme": read README* or any file in the repo, run `sleep 30`, then summarize it in one line.
Then wait for both with get_subagent_result (wait: true) and reply with both results in two lines.
